sn56.20:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these four things are actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:1.3: “‘This is suffering’: this, bhikkhus, is actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:1.4: ‘This is the origin of suffering’: this is actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:1.5: ‘This is the cessation of suffering’: this is actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:1.6: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering’: this is actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:1.7: “These four things, bhikkhus, are actual, unerring, not otherwise.
sn56.20:2.1: “Therefore, bhikkhu, an exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is suffering.’… An exertion should be made to understand: ‘This is the way leading to the cessation of suffering.’”
